description: This file contains utility functions related to avatar handling and string manipulation for a resident management system. It includes functions for generating initials, constructing avatar URLs, locally accessing avatar assets, and generating alt text.

methods.name: debounce(fn, delay = 250)
methods.description: Debounces function calls to limit execution rate, delaying invocation until after delay period has passed without new calls.

methods.name: initialsFromName(name)
methods.description: Generates initials from a full name string, e.g., 'Alice Johnson' -> 'AJ'.

methods.name: buildPlaceholderAvatar(seed, name)
methods.description: Builds a deterministic URL for a placeholder avatar using Dicebear Initials API, based on seed and name.

methods.name: getLocalAvatarAsset(id, slug)
methods.description: Attempts to load a local avatar SVG asset by id or slug from specified assets directory.

methods.name: getResidentAvatarUrl(resident)
methods.description: Retrieves the most appropriate avatar URL for a resident, prioritizing explicit image/avatar, then local assets, then a generated placeholder.

methods.name: avatarAltText(name)
methods.description: Generates accessible alt text for a resident avatar based on the resident's name.
